questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes or shift your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. This sign alerts you to a flagger ahead. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to be alert for a side road crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs with a bright yellow-green background warn of upcoming conditions like sharp turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and look both ways before proceeding. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: Two lanes going the same direction will merge into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells traffic to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until it is clear and safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line means the action is prohibited. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs tell drivers that an action is prohibited. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way and should turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must give the right-of-way to other traffic and pedestrians. Slow down and let them cross before you go. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this sign on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you to move in the direction the arrow points, in this case to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign tells you to slow down because the road ahead will make a sharp, extreme change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: "Yield" means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass. After you yield, you may proceed with the remaining directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. It is illegal to turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to unsafe conditions and are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet and is harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop if a train is coming. Only cross when you are sure no trains are approaching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must let traffic on the main road pass before you proceed. You do not need to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but slow down and enter carefully.
